about.title: About Us
about.storyP1: Polga Design is a firm specialized in landscape architecture and garden design, creating creative and constructive solutions tailored to customer needs. We continuously improve ourselves and deliver innovative solutions to provide the highest quality service.
about.storyP2: With our experienced team and modern approach, we add a unique touch to every project and turn our customers' dreams into reality.
about.missionText: To create nature-friendly, sustainable and aesthetic landscape designs that make living spaces more beautiful and functional.
about.visionText: To become one of Turkey's leading landscape architecture firms, setting standards in the industry and offering innovative solutions.
